title_en: Long-Term Visit Pass Holders Renting a Room
summary_en: Whether Long-Term Visit Pass or Dependant's Pass holders can rent an HDB room, and what to confirm before signing.
body_en:
Not every pass works the same way when it comes to renting an HDB room. If you're on a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) or a Dependant's Pass (DP), here's what generally applies, and what's worth double-checking before you commit.

The general eligibility rule

Non-citizens legally residing in Singapore on an Employment Pass, S Pass, Work Permit, Student's Pass, Dependant's Pass, or Long-Term Visit Pass can generally rent an HDB flat or bedroom, as long as the pass is valid for at least 6 more months at the time of application. The minimum rental period for any HDB room or flat is 6 months.

What to check before you commit

  • Confirm your specific pass still has at least 6 months of validity left — if it's close to expiry, sort out a renewal first, or your rental application could run into trouble.
  • Renting just a bedroom doesn't count towards HDB's non-citizen quota, so this route is often simpler than renting a whole flat.
  • Rules on eligible passes can change, so check the current list on HDB's eligibility page before you sign anything or pay a deposit.

If you're on a Dependant's Pass tied to a work pass holder

Your eligibility is generally tied to your own pass being valid, not directly to your sponsor's job stability day to day — but if your sponsor's work pass is cancelled, your DP is usually cancelled too, which affects your room tenancy. Keep this timeline in mind when agreeing a lease length.

Ask your landlord to double-check

Since the owner is the one applying to HDB for approval, ask them to confirm your pass type is accepted before you commit to anything. It protects both of you from a rejected application after money has changed hands.

General guidance, November 2026 — not legal advice. Confirm current eligibility on hdb.gov.sg.

facts_checked.claim: Non-citizens holding an Employment Pass, S Pass, Work Permit, Student's Pass, Dependant's Pass or Long-Term Visit Pass valid for at least 6 more months can generally rent an HDB flat or bedroom, with a minimum rental period of 6 months
